stop.why: ADR-0010's `stop` venue — typecheck + lint + unit suite, ~2s against a 10s budget. `.claude/settings.json`'s Stop hook already runs exactly this command, so the slot and the hook cannot disagree

test_one.why: vitest's single-file form; there is no package.json script for it

all.why: The definition of green: typecheck + lint + unit suite, the same entry point `.husky/pre-push` and `verify.yml`'s Gauntlet step invoke (Actions additionally runs actionlint, which needs a binary the free venues cannot afford). Named as the runner rather than expanded so this contract and ADR-0010's four venues cannot drift apart (#34) — a check added to the gauntlet is in the gate here the moment it is in the gauntlet
